Ram Mandir CEO selection interviews include personal and professional questions

Interviews for the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) position of the Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Teerth Kshetra Trust began on August 11. The Trust received over 5,300 applications, from which 18 candidates were shortlisted for interviews. Candidates were questioned on various aspects including their administrative experience, vision, faith, and personal habits such as vegetarianism, alcohol consumption, and wearing a 'janeu' (sacred thread). The final decision for the CEO selection rests with the Trust, which has established a 34-point evaluation format for candidates.
